leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function to compute the length of the longest common subsequence between two strings
Construct a dynamic programming table to store intermediate subsequence lengths
Initialize a 2D array with base cases for empty string comparisons
Manipulate the dynamic programming table to fill it with correct subsequence lengths
Apply the recurrence relation to calculate values for each cell in the table
Extract the actual longest common subsequence from the completed table
Integrate the LCS algorithm into a complete JavaScript function that returns both length and sequence
